title: Respectful Communication Skills
description: This course teaches participants how to communicate respectfully, listen actively, and express needs without causing harm.
learningOutcomes: Learn the foundations of respectful communication.
Understand how listening improves safety and trust.
Develop skills for expressing needs without aggression.
Recognise how respectful communication supports children’s wellbeing.

modules.title: Active Listening Skills
modules.content: Teaches presence, validation, and non-defensive listening.

modules.title: Expressing Needs Safely
modules.content: Provides tools for assertive, non-harmful communication.
